units.source_text: 我如释重负，开始同这汉子并肩行走。

en.t: Feeling as if a weight had been lifted from me, I began walking shoulder to shoulder with the man.

units.source_text: 这汉子连珠炮似的向我问东问西。

en.t: The man fired question after question at me, asking about this and that.

units.source_text: 姑娘们看见我们两人谈开了，便从后面急步赶了上来。

en.t: When the girls saw that the two of us had started talking, they hurried up from behind to catch up with us.
